meta: Memorize 50 new words and forget most of them a week later? Learning English vocabulary with AI in context sticks longer.

muc.title: Memorized, then forgotten
muc.text: Memorize fifty new words and you'll forget most of them a week later. Learning in context with AI sticks longer.

muc.title: Words that fit your life
muc.text: Give AI a word and ask for three sentences about your own life, like work, cooking or football.

muc.title: Learn whole phrases
muc.text: Ask AI for the phrases the word usually comes in, because native speakers talk in chunks, not word by word.

muc.title: Write sentences for AI to check
muc.text: The next day, write your own sentences with the word and ask AI to correct them and explain briefly.

muc.title: Today's three words
muc.text: Pick three English words you saw today and ask a chatbot to make sentences about your own job.
